note: Accepted-exceptions + known-pending baseline that makes the name-collision gate a RATCHET, not a wall. The gate is GREEN today (every entry below is covered) but blocks any NEW real-name-for-fiction collision (a new term, or a known term appearing in a NEW file/scope). knownPending items are owner-decision-gated renames tracked in CONTENT_INTEGRITY_SWEEP.md — not blocking, but a fresh occurrence outside the recorded scope re-opens the class.

accepted.note: Documentary rationale for what the curated dictionary deliberately does NOT flag. These classes are legitimate uses of real names and are kept OUT of the dictionary rather than baselined per-file.
accepted.publicDomainMyth: Public-domain mythology used as itself (Mercury, Vesna, Emer, Norse/Greek/Roman gods) — e.g. tunya's alien goddess 'Mercury' (25 refs).
accepted.realGeographyAsItself: Real geography referenced as itself (Manhattan, Africa, Eurasia).
accepted.realScientistsInGrounding: Real scientists cited as themselves in content/grounding/** (Newton, Turing, ...).
accepted.realMedicalTerms: Real medical/disease terminology in content/diseases/** and content/healthcare-protocols.json.
accepted.genreVocab: Generic genre vocabulary that is not a trademark (orc, elf, netrunner, mutant, ...).
accepted.cc0AssetSources: Real CC0 / open asset-source attributions in content/evo-seed/**.
